# Alln1 Business

> Alln1 Business helps small businesses nationwide win more sales, run smarter marketing, stay active on social media and run on connected systems, all powered by AI.

Alln1 Business serves small businesses nationwide and is based in Houston, TX. Contact: Alln1 Business, Houston, TX, liz@alln1business.com, (281) 810-3315.

## Services

- [AI Audit & Roadmap](https://alln1business.com/ai-audit): For owners who want a practical plan before choosing tools or paying for a build. $497.
- [AI Agent Systems](https://alln1business.com/ai-agent-systems): For businesses whose calls, chat, sales and operations need to share context rather than act like separate assistants..
- [AI Revenue Systems](https://alln1business.com/ai-revenue-systems): For service businesses that need inquiries, bookings, quotes and payments to move through one connected pipeline..
- [Integrations & Automation](https://alln1business.com/integrations-automation): For businesses with useful apps that still require someone to copy the same information from one place to another..
- [AI Ops Infrastructure](https://alln1business.com/ai-ops-infrastructure): For teams spending too much of the week sorting email, chasing documents and moving information into task or bookkeeping tools..
- [AI Growth Systems](https://alln1business.com/ai-growth-systems): For businesses that want local search, reviews and approved content connected to a real lead-management process..
- [Managed AI Ops](https://alln1business.com/managed-ai-ops): For owners who already have connected systems and want monitoring, maintenance and agreed improvements after launch. Optional care after launch.
- [AI-Ready Business Launch](https://alln1business.com/ai-ready-business-launch): For a new business that needs its paperwork, identity and digital tools to work together from the start..
- [Business Launch](https://alln1business.com/launch): Start your business already connected: DBA/LLC filing prepared, bank-ready paperwork, brand, website, email, Google Business Profile and AI from day one..
- [AI Integration Services & Pricing](https://alln1business.com/services): AI Agent Systems, AI Revenue Systems, Integrations & Automation, AI Ops Infrastructure and AI Growth Systems. AI Audit $497.
- [AI email sorting & reply drafts](https://alln1business.com/ai-email-drafts): Separate routine messages from those needing attention, then prepare replies without giving AI a blank check to send. Part of AI Ops Infrastructure.
- [Booking confirmations & reminders](https://alln1business.com/booking-reminders): Connect the appointment record, intake and reminders so the calendar and CRM tell the same story. Part of AI Revenue Systems.
- [AI content planning & approval](https://alln1business.com/content-batch): Build a repeatable content workflow around your real services and approved source material, not made-up case studies. Part of AI Growth Systems.
- [Inbox & document triage](https://alln1business.com/inbox-triage): Route incoming email and attachments to the right folder or task, with a clear record of what still needs a human decision. Part of AI Ops Infrastructure.
- [AI invoice & receipt reader](https://alln1business.com/invoice-receipt-reader): Extract the useful fields from paperwork and prepare organized bookkeeping inputs without letting AI move your money. Part of AI Ops Infrastructure.
- [Lead capture & follow-up](https://alln1business.com/lead-follow-up): Bring new inquiries into one pipeline, then follow up using the customer’s context instead of a disconnected spreadsheet. Part of AI Revenue Systems.
- [AI meeting notes to tasks](https://alln1business.com/meeting-notes-tasks): Turn an approved meeting transcript into a reviewable summary and action list that reaches the tools your team actually uses. Part of AI Ops Infrastructure.
- [Missed-call text-back](https://alln1business.com/missed-call-textback): Give callers a clear next step when you cannot answer, with the conversation saved alongside the lead. Part of AI Revenue Systems.
- [AI quote & proposal drafts](https://alln1business.com/quote-proposal): Turn intake details into a consistent first draft, with your current scope and pricing as the source. Part of AI Revenue Systems.
- [Review requests & AI reply drafts](https://alln1business.com/review-requests): Connect completed work to a neutral review invitation, then give the owner a draft response grounded in the real review. Part of AI Growth Systems.
- [Connected operations dashboard](https://alln1business.com/spreadsheet-dashboard): Keep a useful view of leads, jobs or paperwork connected to its source instead of updating every cell by hand. Part of Integrations & Automation.
- [Business plan & brand foundation](https://alln1business.com/starter-plan-brand): Connect the business basics, brand and website to the systems you will use after launch, rather than treating them as disconnected deliverables. Part of AI-Ready Business Launch.
- [AI website chat & handoff](https://alln1business.com/website-chat): An AI assistant answers from your own service information and hands off when a person needs to take over. Part of AI Agent Systems.

- [Stop losing jobs to missed calls](https://alln1business.com/ai-phone-receptionist): An AI receptionist for Houston shops answers the existing number, rings the owner for transfer words, and waits for approval on prices and bookings. Texts need carrier approval. Not a live line on the page.
- [Old-customer reactivation](https://alln1business.com/customer-reactivation): Finds past customers who went quiet and drafts personal win-back offers for the owner to approve. Part of AI Revenue Systems.
- [AI search visibility check](https://alln1business.com/ai-search-visibility): Shows whether the business comes up in ChatGPT, Google AI answers and similar tools, with a fix list. Part of AI Growth Systems.
- [Bilingual AI: English and Spanish](https://alln1business.com/bilingual-ai): Phone, chat and follow-ups that switch to Spanish when the customer does. It fits Houston and Texas businesses. Part of AI Agent Systems.
- [Owner’s daily AI briefing](https://alln1business.com/owner-daily-briefing): One short morning email with new leads, bookings, reviews and unpaid invoices. Part of AI Ops Infrastructure.

## Software workflows and accounting review designs

These are custom-build possibilities, not claimed tested demos or live deployments. Vendor API/plan access must be verified in the $497 AI Audit. AI drafts; a human approves every accounting entry before posting. A CPA reviews tax items. No autonomous payments or filing. Third-party software and usage costs are separate.

- [AI Workflows for Xero](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-xero): Prepare Xero bookkeeping inputs, organize invoice evidence and flag exceptions for human review. Custom integrations scoped around your account and API access.
- [AI Workflows for Jobber & Housecall Pro](https://alln1business.com/field-service-ai-workflows): Connect field-service intake, job paperwork and office handoffs around Jobber or Housecall Pro. API eligibility and human approval checked before a custom build.
- [AI Workflows for Shopify & WooCommerce](https://alln1business.com/ecommerce-ai-workflows): Prepare order exceptions, support drafts and payout bookkeeping reviews for Shopify or WooCommerce, with realistic API permissions and human approval.
- [Microsoft 365 AI Workflows](https://alln1business.com/microsoft-365-ai-workflows): Connect Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive and review queues using scoped Microsoft Graph access. Custom AI workflow design, not an unsupported Copilot promise.
- [Google Workspace AI Workflows](https://alln1business.com/google-workspace-ai-workflows): Organize Gmail, Drive and Sheets handoffs with consent, scoped APIs and reviewable AI drafts. Access and verification requirements checked before a build.
- [PO, Receipt & Invoice Matching](https://alln1business.com/ai-three-way-matching): Compare purchase orders, receiving evidence and supplier invoices in a human-reviewed exception queue. No automatic bill approval, payment or invented receipt data.
- [Chart-of-Accounts Cleanup Prep](https://alln1business.com/chart-of-accounts-cleanup): Find duplicate account labels and inconsistent coding, then prepare a bookkeeper-reviewed cleanup map. No automatic merges, deletions or historical reclassification.
- [Bank and card reconciliation preparation](https://alln1business.com/ai-month-end-close#bank-card-reconciliation): Authorized statement/export working papers, not automated bank reconciliation.
- [W-9 and 1099 readiness](https://alln1business.com/ai-tax-organizer#w9-1099-readiness): Restricted document-status tracking and CPA-reviewed evidence, not TIN verification or filing.

## AI by industry packages

Staged package roadmaps (starting out, growing, established). Each stage's "from" price is the published starting setup price of an existing Alln1 offer: AI-Ready Business Launch (Launch + AI Systems) AI Ops Infrastructure AI Revenue Systems AI Agent Systems. Stages are alternative starting points, not cumulative tiers; exact scope follows the $497 AI Audit. Example stories on these pages are fictional. No client results, testimonials, partnerships, rankings or citations are claimed. Humans approve accounting entries, a CPA or authorized preparer reviews tax items, attorneys control legal work and confidentiality, and there are no autonomous payments or filings.

- [AI for Accounting & Bookkeeping Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-accounting-firms): A staged AI package for bookkeeping and accounting firms: document chasing, close readiness, client questions and staff knowledge, with human review on every entry.
- [You cannot answer the phone and turn a wrench](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-home-services): The three leaks Houston HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing and cleaning owners describe, a starter set of four automations, and the full list. A person sets prices. Connects to Jobber, Housecall Pro and QuickBooks.
- [AI for Houston Salons and Barbers](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-salons-barbers): Rebooks, waitlists, no-show notes, deposits and loyalty reminders, set up in the booking tools salons and barbers already use.
- [AI for Houston Insurance Agencies](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-insurance-agencies): Renewal lists, one-policy check-ins, and certificate drafts for independent agencies. A licensed person approves every note and every certificate.
- [AI for Houston Property Managers](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-property-management): Work orders, rent reminders, lease renewals, showing questions, and application flags. A person decides. No automated tenant decisions.
- [AI for Houston and Texas Real Estate Agents](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-real-estate-agents): Contract date reminders, listing drafts, and showing-feedback summaries. The agent and the broker confirm dates.
- [AI for Construction & Real Estate Development](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-construction-development): A staged AI package for builders, contractors and real estate developers: job costs, vendor paperwork, COI tracking, meeting follow-through and owner visibility, with owner approval.
- [AI for Tax Preparation Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-tax-firms): A staged AI package for tax preparers and small tax firms: document readiness, missing-item requests, status answers and secure handoff. Preparers review; no filing or tax advice by AI.
- [AI for Small Law Firms](https://alln1business.com/ai-for-law-firms): A staged AI package for solo and small law firms: answer inquiries, schedule consultations and handle admin follow-through. Attorneys control conflicts, legal work and confidentiality.

## Reading this site accurately

Service descriptions and example flows are proposed custom-build possibilities unless explicitly labeled otherwise. A video illustration is not proof of a tested or live deployment. Tests, launch permissions, review rules and optional support coverage are agreed in scope. Metadata and this file support discoverability; they do not guarantee search rankings, AI citations, traffic or revenue. The Book an AI Audit button opens an inquiry: Liz replies to arrange the audit; it does not reserve a calendar time or take payment.
